'''Askarian worms''' were [[Worm/Legends|worms]] from the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] system [[Askaria system/Legends|Askaria]]. The [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] [[Variise]] once compared the professional [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]] to one of these after she attacked him with her [[shock whip]].<ref name="Easy">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref>
